## Items

### <a id="rel-001"></a>REL-001 · Developer Preview

**Release** · ◐ In Progress · version 0.1.0 · owner MisanaProger

The first public release: the core learning loop of spec v0.3 (stages 0–7, 9 and the shipped part of stage 8) and the desktop window on Linux. Privacy controls are in scope because a public build must let the learner delete their data.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] CI is green on the release commit
- [ ] Privacy controls (PRD-046) are done
- [ ] README.md, README.ru.md and README.uz.md describe installation and first steps
- [ ] The commit is tagged v0.1.0 and release notes list the scope below
